review_notes.zh-CN: 供审阅的文案草稿，尚未写入游戏。按棋盘布局和引擎规则编写，未逐关完成通关验证。目标格统一称为目标；终点与目标分开表述。AntiGravity 是否必需尚未逐关核实，当前不把任何关卡标记为必须使用。
review_notes.en: Copy draft for review; not applied to the game. Based on board layouts and engine rules, without a completed playthrough of every level. Collectibles are called objectives; the goal is the destination. AntiGravity requirements have not been verified per level, so no level is currently labeled as requiring it.

introduction.zh-CN: 开启 AntiGravity 后，棋子会向上浮起；关闭后恢复向下掉落。
introduction.en: Turn on AntiGravity to make your pieces rise; turn it off to restore downward gravity.

antigravity.assignment_note: 仅在核实对应关卡确实无法在普通重力下通关后，才将 required_level_template 改写为该关的具体提示。

levels.zh-CN: 王每次可向任意方向走一格。
levels.en: The king moves one square in any direction.

levels.zh-CN: 马走日字，可以跳过障碍。
levels.en: The knight moves in an L and can jump over obstacles.

levels.zh-CN: 单向方块只能沿箭头方向通过。
levels.en: Phase blocks can only be passed through in the arrow's direction.

levels.zh-CN: 变身格可以改变棋子的类型。
levels.en: Transformers let you change a piece's type.

levels.zh-CN: 收集所有目标后才能进入终点。
levels.en: Collect all objectives to unlock the goal.

levels.zh-CN: 终点倒计数归零后会锁定。
levels.en: The goal locks when its counter reaches zero.

levels.zh-CN: 小心炸弹。
levels.en: Watch out for bombs!

levels.zh-CN: 车只能横向或纵向移动。
levels.en: The rook moves only horizontally or vertically.

levels.zh-CN: 三个目标全部收集后，终点才会解锁。
levels.en: Collect all three objectives to unlock the goal.

levels.zh-CN: 象只能沿斜线移动。
levels.en: The bishop moves only diagonally.

levels.zh-CN: 马能跳过墙壁，但不能落在墙上。
levels.en: The knight can jump over walls, but cannot land on them.

levels.zh-CN: 可以切换控制棋子，任意一枚到达终点即可。
levels.en: Switch between pieces. Any one of them can reach the goal to finish.

levels.zh-CN: 不同类型的棋子有不同的走法。
levels.en: Each piece type has its own movement rules.

levels.zh-CN: 后可以横向、纵向或斜向移动。
levels.en: The queen moves horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.

levels.zh-CN: 移动任意棋子，炸弹也会移动。
levels.en: Moving any piece also moves the bombs.

levels.zh-CN: 点击不同棋子，可以切换控制。
levels.en: Click a different piece to control it.

levels.zh-CN: 终点倒计数归零后，即使到达也无法通关。
levels.en: Once the goal's counter reaches zero, reaching it will not finish the level.

levels.zh-CN: 单向方块只能沿箭头方向通过。
levels.en: Phase blocks can only be passed through in the arrow's direction.

levels.zh-CN: 棋子可以互相支撑，移开下方棋子会让上方棋子下落。
levels.en: Pieces can support each other. Moving a lower piece lets those above fall.

levels.zh-CN: 棋子不能穿过其他棋子。
levels.en: Pieces cannot pass through other pieces.

levels.zh-CN: 象走斜线，车走直线。
levels.en: The bishop moves diagonally; the rook moves in straight lines.

levels.zh-CN: 顶部两端的目标都要收集。
levels.en: Collect the objectives at both ends of the top row.

levels.zh-CN: 不同棋子收集的目标会合并计算。
levels.en: Objectives collected by different pieces count toward the same total.

levels.zh-CN: 变身后，棋子按新的类型移动。
levels.en: After transforming, a piece follows its new type's movement rules.

levels.zh-CN: 三个目标都要收集，顺序不限。
levels.en: Collect all three objectives in any order.

levels.zh-CN: 切换棋子不会重置终点倒计数。
levels.en: Switching pieces does not reset the goal's counter.

levels.zh-CN: 所有棋子共用同一个终点倒计数。
levels.en: All pieces share the same goal counter.

levels.zh-CN: 收集两个目标后，还要在倒计数归零前到达终点。
levels.en: Collect both objectives and reach the goal before its counter reaches zero.

levels.zh-CN: 收集目标不会重置终点倒计数。
levels.en: Collecting an objective does not reset the goal's counter.

levels.zh-CN: 到达变身格后，可以选择新的棋子类型。
levels.en: Reach a transformer to choose a new piece type.

levels.zh-CN: 迷雾只显示棋子可到达的格子。
levels.en: Fog reveals only squares your pieces can reach.

levels.zh-CN: 象可以沿斜线向上或向下移动。
levels.en: The bishop can move diagonally upward or downward.

levels.zh-CN: 王每次可向任意方向走一格。
levels.en: The king moves one square in any direction.

levels.zh-CN: 棋子失去支撑时会向下掉落。
levels.en: Pieces fall when they lose support.

levels.zh-CN: 单向方块只能沿箭头方向通过。
levels.en: Phase blocks can only be passed through in the arrow's direction.

levels.zh-CN: 马可以跳过障碍，象不能。
levels.en: The knight can jump over obstacles; the bishop cannot.

levels.zh-CN: 即使终点就在旁边，也要先收集所有目标。
levels.en: Even if the goal is nearby, collect all objectives first.

levels.zh-CN: 三个目标全部收集后，身旁的终点才会解锁。
levels.en: Collect all three objectives to unlock the nearby goal.

levels.zh-CN: 后不能跳过障碍，马可以。
levels.en: The queen cannot jump over obstacles; the knight can.

levels.zh-CN: 变身格可以让车改用其他棋子的走法。
levels.en: A transformer lets the rook take on another piece type's moves.

levels.zh-CN: 收集目标后，还需要到达终点。
levels.en: After collecting the objective, you still need to reach the goal.

levels.zh-CN: 可以用不同棋子分别收集目标和到达终点。
levels.en: One piece can collect the objective while another reaches the goal.

levels.zh-CN: 变身只改变选中棋子的类型。
levels.en: Transforming changes only the selected piece's type.

levels.zh-CN: 移开下方棋子，会改变上方棋子的支撑。
levels.en: Moving a lower piece changes the support for pieces above it.

levels.zh-CN: 马的跳跃不受沿途障碍影响。
levels.en: Obstacles along the way do not block a knight's jump.

levels.zh-CN: 任意一枚棋子都可以收集目标。
levels.en: Any of your pieces can collect the objective.

levels.zh-CN: 王可以斜向走一格。
levels.en: The king can move one square diagonally.

levels.zh-CN: 迷雾不会改变王的走法。
levels.en: Fog does not change how the king moves.

levels.zh-CN: 马能跳过炸弹，但落点不能是炸弹所在格。
levels.en: The knight can jump over bombs, but cannot land on one.

levels.zh-CN: 迷雾下仍需在倒计数归零前到达终点。
levels.en: Under fog, you must still reach the goal before its counter reaches zero.

levels.zh-CN: 这种炸弹会斜向移动。
levels.en: This bomb type moves diagonally.

levels.zh-CN: 进入传送门，会传送到同色的另一端。
levels.en: Entering a portal sends you to its matching-color partner.

levels.zh-CN: 易位操作：先选中王，再点击符合条件的特殊车。
levels.en: To castle, select the king, then click an eligible special rook.

levels.zh-CN: 不同颜色的传送门互不连通。
levels.en: Portals of different colors do not connect.

levels.zh-CN: 移动平台会随行动升降。
levels.en: The moving platform rises and falls with your actions.

levels.zh-CN: 站在移动平台上的棋子会随平台移动。
levels.en: A piece standing on a moving platform moves with it.

levels.zh-CN: 同色传送门成对连接。
levels.en: Portals connect in matching-color pairs.

levels.zh-CN: 王和特殊车都未移动过，才有可能易位。
levels.en: Castling requires both the king and special rook to be unmoved.

levels.zh-CN: 变身后仍需收集全部三个目标。
levels.en: You still need all three objectives after transforming.

levels.zh-CN: 易位会同时改变王和特殊车的位置。
levels.en: Castling repositions both the king and the special rook.

levels.zh-CN: 马和象收集的目标会合并计算。
levels.en: Objectives collected by the knight and bishop count toward the same total.

levels.zh-CN: 移动任意棋子，平台都会移动。
levels.en: Moving either piece also moves the platform.

levels.zh-CN: 三个目标和终点共用这段倒计数。
levels.en: Collect all three objectives and reach the goal within the same counter.

levels.zh-CN: 易位后，仍需收集全部三个目标。
levels.en: After castling, you still need to collect all three objectives.

levels.zh-CN: 后和马可以分别收集不同的目标。
levels.en: The queen and knight can collect separate objectives.

levels.zh-CN: 紫色传送门只连接另一扇紫色传送门。
levels.en: A purple portal connects only to its purple partner.

levels.zh-CN: 单向方块只能沿箭头方向通过。
levels.en: Phase blocks can only be passed through in the arrow's direction.

levels.zh-CN: 三个目标全部收集后，终点才会解锁。
levels.en: Collect all three objectives to unlock the goal.

levels.zh-CN: 马可以跳过障碍，王每次只能走一格。
levels.en: The knight can jump over obstacles; the king moves only one square at a time.

levels.zh-CN: 兵向上直走，首次移动可前进两格。
levels.en: The pawn moves straight upward and may advance two squares on its first move.

levels.zh-CN: 鸭子会随行动横移，直接碰到会失败。
levels.en: Ducks move sideways with your actions. Direct contact ends the run.

levels.zh-CN: 可以站在鸭子上方，随它移动。
levels.en: You can stand above a duck and ride with it.

levels.zh-CN: 鸭子可以载着棋子横向移动。
levels.en: Ducks can carry pieces sideways.

levels.zh-CN: 两排鸭子的移动方向相反。
levels.en: The two rows of ducks move in opposite directions.

levels.zh-CN: 两个目标全部收集后，终点才会解锁。
levels.en: Collect both objectives to unlock the goal.

levels.zh-CN: 站在鸭子上方，车也能随鸭子横移。
levels.en: A rook standing above a duck rides sideways with it.

levels.zh-CN: 移动平台也可以横向移动。
levels.en: Moving platforms can also travel horizontally.

levels.zh-CN: 易位需要王与特殊车之间没有障碍。
levels.en: Castling requires a clear path between the king and special rook.

levels.zh-CN: 鸭子载着象横移后，象仍然只能走斜线。
levels.en: After a duck carries the bishop sideways, the bishop still moves only diagonally.

levels.zh-CN: 平台会载着上方的棋子一起横移。
levels.en: The platform carries the piece above it sideways.

levels.zh-CN: 兵的两格前进只在首次移动时可用。
levels.en: The pawn's two-square advance is available only on its first move.

levels.zh-CN: 蓝色传送门只连接另一扇蓝色传送门。
levels.en: A blue portal connects only to its blue partner.

levels.zh-CN: 绿色传送门只连接另一扇绿色传送门。
levels.en: A green portal connects only to its green partner.

levels.zh-CN: 兵可以在变身格改成其他类型的棋子。
levels.en: The pawn can change into another piece type at a transformer.

levels.zh-CN: 兵可以斜向前进一格，吃掉目标。
levels.en: The pawn can move one square diagonally forward to capture an objective.

levels.zh-CN: 移动棋子时，平台、鸭子和炸弹都会移动。
levels.en: Moving a piece also moves the platform, ducks, and bombs.

levels.zh-CN: 蓝色和橙色传送门分别成对连接。
levels.en: Blue and orange portals form separate matching pairs.

levels.zh-CN: 橙色传送门只连接另一扇橙色传送门。
levels.en: An orange portal connects only to its orange partner.

levels.zh-CN: 三块平台都沿横向移动。
levels.en: All three platforms move horizontally.

levels.zh-CN: 兵不能横走，但可以由鸭子载着横移。
levels.en: The pawn cannot move sideways, but a duck can carry it sideways.

levels.zh-CN: 移动平台和传送门都不会改变马的走法。
levels.en: Neither the platform nor the portals change the knight's movement rules.

levels.zh-CN: 到达变身格后，可以重新选择棋子类型。
levels.en: Reach the transformer to choose a new piece type.

levels.zh-CN: 沿移动路线经过目标，也能完成收集。
levels.en: Objectives along your movement path are collected as you pass through them.

levels.zh-CN: 车与象共用同一个终点倒计数。
levels.en: The rook and bishop share the same goal counter.

levels.zh-CN: 两枚棋子收集的目标会合并计算。
levels.en: Objectives collected by either piece count toward the same total.

levels.zh-CN: 倒计数不会因使用传送门而重置。
levels.en: Using a portal does not reset the goal's counter.

levels.zh-CN: 马可以跳过鸭子，但不能落在鸭子所在格。
levels.en: The knight can jump over ducks, but cannot land on one.

levels.zh-CN: 兵可以斜向前进一格，吃掉目标。
levels.en: The pawn can move one square diagonally forward to capture an objective.

levels.zh-CN: 这关增加了迷雾和终点倒计数。
levels.en: This version adds fog and a goal counter.

levels.zh-CN: 移开下面的马，会让失去支撑的马下落。
levels.en: Moving a lower knight makes unsupported knights above it fall.

levels.zh-CN: 激光沿亮边方向发射，按行动次数触发。
levels.en: Lasers fire in the directions marked by bright edges, triggered by action count.

levels.zh-CN: 不同激光方块的发射周期可以不同。
levels.en: Different laser blocks can have different firing intervals.

levels.zh-CN: 必须先吃掉黑色目标棋子，才能进入终点。
levels.en: Capture the black target piece to unlock the goal.

levels.zh-CN: 原地跳跃也算行动，可以调整激光发射时机。
levels.en: A hop in place counts as an action and can shift laser timing.

levels.zh-CN: 收集两个目标并吃掉三枚黑棋后，终点才会解锁。
levels.en: Collect both objectives and capture all three black pieces to unlock the goal.

copy_style.zh-CN: 只写核心规则、机制区别或通关条件；允许重复，不添加泛泛的路线建议。
copy_style.en: State only a core rule, mechanic distinction, or completion requirement. Repetition is allowed; omit generic route advice.
